summary.text: Ken Weyler is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 14 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
An Air Force veteran and former American Airlines pilot with a chemical engineering degree, he chaired the House Finance Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Ken Weyler was born in Boston, Massachusetts, lives in New Hampshire, and graduated from Newton High School in Newton, Massachusetts.

He earned a B.S. in chemical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1963, served in the U.S. Air Force from 1963 to 1969 and in the Air Force Reserves from 1969 to 1993, and worked as a first officer, captain and pilot for American Airlines.
Weyler served on the Kingston Planning Board and the Regional Planning Commission.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2010.

He chaired the House Finance Committee in the 2023-2024 session and had served on the House Finance Committee, the Fiscal Committee and the Legislative Facilities Committee in 2021-2022, when he also served as clerk of the Finance - Division III Committee.
